ITA-9.1.46 laṅghanam लङ्घनम्
Lightness promoting therapy
One of the six types of treatment modalities: a procedure that induces lightness in the body.

ITA-5.76.18 laṅghana-atiyogaḥ लङ्घन-अतियोगः
Condition of excessive depletion therapy

ITA-5.76.17 laṅghana-apacāraḥ लङ्घन-अपचारः
Condition due to improper depletion therapy
